clients.headline: From mobility and healthcare to finance and retail, I’ve worked with teams at —

featuredProjects.title: Fleet Management System
featuredProjects.summary: A unified enterprise platform delivering real-time vehicle telematics, route optimization algorithms, predictive maintenance warnings, and driver health analytics across 10,000+ active fleet vehicles.
featuredProjects.challenge: Dispatch managers were juggling five disparate legacy interfaces with slow refresh rates, high cognitive load, and delayed emergency response times.
featuredProjects.solution: Designed a clean, dark-mode cockpit with hierarchical information density, real-time map clustering, and single-click driver dispatch workflows that reduced reaction times by 42%.

featuredProjects.title: Royal Enfield’s Digital Ecosystem
featuredProjects.tagline: Connected Rider App & In-Cluster Companion Experience
featuredProjects.summary: An end-to-end digital experience connecting the rider's motorcycle cluster with their mobile app, turn-by-turn navigation, ride metrics, and community ride events.
featuredProjects.challenge: Riders needed distraction-free navigation while cruising on highways, with high contrast visibility under direct sunlight and seamless Bluetooth LE auto-reconnect.
featuredProjects.solution: Engineered high-contrast, minimalist cluster HUD states combined with an intuitive companion app featuring offline topographic map routing and one-tap emergency SOS beaconing.

featuredProjects.title: Smart Switch Automation
featuredProjects.tagline: Next-Gen IoT Smart Home Touch Controller
featuredProjects.summary: A sleek embedded touch glass interface and companion mobile application enabling contextual ambient lighting, energy monitoring, and AI-scheduled device automation.
featuredProjects.challenge: Traditional smart switch controls are cluttered with complex menus, making physical micro-interactions slow and unintuitive for all age groups in a home.
featuredProjects.solution: Created haptic-feedback spatial micro-gestures and dynamic ambient lighting themes that adapt to the time of day, room occupancy, and energy conservation goals.

projects.title: PuzzleYou - Game Design
projects.description: An engaging mobile puzzle game exploring spatial cognition, haptic feedback loops, and minimalist typography.
projects.details: Conducted research on cognitive psychology and tactile reward systems. Built interactive micro-animations with physics-based springs and custom SVG particle bursts.

projects.title: Elderly Ergonomic Infotainment Screen
projects.description: Inclusive in-vehicle touchscreen interface designed for senior drivers with high contrast, oversized target areas, and voice-assisted confirmations.
projects.details: Designed according to WCAG AAA guidelines and SAE ergonomic automotive standards. Features ambient voice feedback, zero-depth menu hierarchies, and anti-glare typography.

projects.title: Employee Wellbeing IoT Application
projects.description: Workplace ergonomic companion tracking posture, desk height, and screen time to promote healthy habits in corporate environments.
projects.details: Integrated Bluetooth desk sensor telemetry into a cheerful, non-intrusive desktop widget with gentle micro-break reminders and team posture challenges.

projects.title: JSL Annual Report '24
projects.description: An interactive, data-dense digital annual report featuring animated financial charts, ESG impact visualizers, and leadership letters.
projects.details: Crafted interactive scrollytelling experiences for stakeholder disclosure. Boosted average investor session duration from 1.5 minutes to 7.8 minutes.

projects.title: Royal Enfield Motoverse Website
projects.description: Official festival website for Royal Enfield Motoverse, India's largest motorcycle culture and music festival held in Goa.
projects.details: Designed high-octane visual identity with 3D motorcycle customizers, artist schedule timelines, ticket checkout flows, and interactive festival venue maps.

outOfOffice.narrative: Every few months, I take a break from work and travel. Even a short weekend itinerary gives me a sense that life is larger than the bubble I live in. Each visit leaves me inspired, bringing a fresh perspective back to my life and work.
outOfOffice.whyDesignQuestion: Why design? My answer is simple.
outOfOffice.whyDesignAnswer: I travel places, meet new people, observe their culture closely. The hobby is the same as the work, really: connect with people, explore new ground, and build towards a life that feels easy.

photos.caption: High altitude silence and endless horizons.
Winding roads that test patience and reward courage.
Where cliffs meet the Arabian Sea at sunset.
Morning mist through old pine trees.
Colors, culture, and architecture etched in time.
Wooden houses with stories from generations past.
Overlooking the Kangra valley under a golden canopy.
Red cliffs and slow evenings listening to waves.

workExperience.description: Spearheaded 0-to-1 design strategy and UI execution for key automotive, IoT, and enterprise clients. Partnered with engineering teams to deploy micro-interactions and scalable design systems for platforms serving 250,000+ active daily users.
Designed user interfaces and interactive prototypes for SaaS analytics dashboards, telematics portals, and consumer applications. Conducted user testing and usability heuristic audits.
